properties.displayName: ImageMagick has a Heap Buffer Over-Write in MAT decoder on 32-bit systems
properties.description: ImageMagick has a Heap Buffer Over-Write in MAT decoder on 32-bit systems
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "imagemagick" or Msg contains "heap" or message_s contains "imagemagick" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP | where count_ > 3 // GHADV-1758
